summary: Architectural analysis (no code changes) of the workspace-view ownership model, identifying that `createWorkspaceView()` grants a single enabled extension privileged ownership over workspace identity, titlebar, inspector, context menu, and editor actions. Proposes a minimal refactor: make `WorkspaceView` app-owned metadata only, flatten static and activated inspector contributions into one peer tab list, demote Unity to a normal `Unity Status` tab with `Console` as a sibling, and remove `createView`, `WorkspacePanel`, `domainId`, `panel`, and `pill` from the extension contract. Includes detailed file/line references, Unity migration steps, settings rename (`showUnityInspector` → `showWorkspaceInspector`), and a test rewrite plan.
decisions: Make `WorkspaceView` app-owned workspace metadata only; remove `domainId`, `canOpen`/`open`/`refresh`, `pill`, `panel` from it
Remove `WorkspacePanel`, `GizmoWebExtension.createView`, and the `createView` validation in `load-web-extension.ts` from the extension contract
Flatten static and activated inspector contributions into a single peer tab list rendered through one identical panel branch
Unity contributes a normal `unity.status` (label `Unity`) static tab; the activated `unity.console` tab is a sibling peer rather than nested under the owner
Use the first available peer tab as the default selection instead of hard-coding `git`, and add an app-owned empty state when no enabled extension contributes a panel
Return `WebExtensionRuntime[]` directly from `activateProjectExtensions()` and dispose them directly, dropping the `{ extensionId, runtime }` wrapper used only for owner filtering
Titlebar displays only app-owned workspace metadata; extension status items remain peers and do not replace workspace title/subtitle
Rename persisted setting `showUnityInspector` to `showWorkspaceInspector`, accepting the legacy value on load while writing only the new key on save
Update accessibility label in `PanelResizeHandle.svelte` from `editor inspector` to `workspace inspector`
Require globally unique tab IDs across extensions (existing extensions already namespace via `unity.console`, `subagents.panel`, `workflows.panel`)
Keep all tab metadata including `shortLabel` and `badgeTone` so the danger badge tone Unity needs reaches the tab shell (currently dropped by the mapping)

Optionally introduce a `enabledWebExtensions(store)` helper to centralize `store.activeDomains` filtering; defer the broader `enabledExtensionIds` rename due to session/protocol 'domain' compatibility
Remove the Unity-specific global context-menu actions in `AppContextMenu.svelte`/`context-target.ts`; Unity still exposes Open Editor via commands and `EditorPanel.svelte`
Svelte browser stub (`packages/svelte/src/web/index.ts` and `extensions/svelte/src/web/index.ts`) is no longer needed for workspace naming
errors: Current mapping drops `shortLabel` and `badgeTone` from tab metadata despite `packages/ui/src/Tabs.svelte:7-12` supporting both, which currently prevents Unity's danger badge tone from reaching the tab shell

Comments in `types.ts:115-119` say static tabs appear whenever an extension is 'installed', but the inspector actually filters through `store.activeDomains` at `WorkspaceInspector.svelte:81` — the comments are inconsistent with actual enablement gating

Current unstaged changes to `WorkspaceInspector.svelte`, `registry.svelte.ts`, and its test preserve runtime ownership so tabs can be nested under the owning domain, which contradicts the requested peer model and should be replaced rather than extended
